text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Like the Shuka Sho, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup is held at Kyoto Racecourse. However, the crowd's excitement was even more intense—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Today it's definitely Still in Love! After all,
she's only the second Triple Tiara Umamusume in history!
That absurd strength of hers is the real deal...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, it was totally crazy, wasn't it?
Just thinking back on it... I still get goosebumps..."

text_block_list.name: Still's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu... Still-chan plushie...
Here's a Still-chan poster.
Still-chan poster, Still plushie...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a complete turn from before, the venue was filled with cheers for Still in Love.
Wanting to share the joy, I went to tell her—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... N-No...!
I'm grateful. Truly...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: If you're feeling anxious, I'm here to listen.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Would it be alright if we do it after the race? Right now, I...
choice_data_list: ...All right. I'll be waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much...
choice_data_list: Go show them what a Triple Tiara winner is made of!
Go show them the strength of a Triple Tiara winner!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Still in Loveeeee!!
Keep it up—!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Their innocent expectations pierce right through me.
So this is what it means to be a Triple Tiara Umamusume...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I have to live up to this—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Oh? Alv-san...
She somehow seems so much gentler...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ――Alv!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Run calmly, just as I taught you.
Do that, and you'll surely demonstrate your true strength.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Above all, calm your mind and run.
There is nothing here that chases you...
Run with composure, as if you were a king!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Alv-san...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...You are strong.
I'll give you that."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I was inexperienced.
...I am sorry."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I still don't know.
Is this the right answer...? But...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've—made up my mind.
I will not give up the throne.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(In such a short time...
Alv-san is completely transformed...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(You've gotten stronger than before.
Tell me... You feel it too, don't you?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey.
Where are you...—"
